scripts.dev: bun run build:packages && bun run --cwd apps/website dev
scripts.check: bun run build:packages && bun run --cwd apps/website check
scripts.build:packages: bun run brand:generate && bun run --cwd packages/aven-ceo build
scripts.build:next: bun run build:packages && PUBLIC_ID_BASE_URL=https://id.next.aven.ceo bun run --cwd apps/website build && bun run --cwd apps/website audit:build next
scripts.build:production: bun run build:packages && PUBLIC_ID_BASE_URL=https://id.aven.ceo bun run --cwd apps/website build && bun run --cwd apps/website audit:build production
